description: External Blocker Model (PHASE G.2, WS1). Registry of program items whose closure CANNOT be achieved by software and requires an external actor (Authority Board, Independent Adjudicator, human Operations, Certification Authority) to perform a governed action. The Constitutional Program Compiler consumes this to distinguish EXTERNAL_BLOCKED from INTERNAL_BLOCKED and to prevent token-wasting rediscovery. Append-only / migration-only per INV-10. Records reality exactly: it designates no actor, produces no attestation, and closes nothing.

externalBlockers.reason: Independent attestation (proposer != attestor) of the self-attested PI-8/PI-9 ratifications, the retroactive AD-0016..0023 enrollment, and the R13/R14 ruling. Self-closure is forbidden (SIG-5 / AUTH-009 Separation of Duties): the authoring/construction chain cannot attest its own work. No software agent can manufacture an independent adjudicator, so this blocker is intrinsically external and permanently non-software-solvable.
externalBlockers.required_actor: UCOS Authority Board (designation) + a distinct Independent Adjudicator (attestation), custodian: Chief Authority Architect
externalBlockers.required_action: G1 designate a distinct-actor Independent Adjudicator (not in authoring/construction chain) -> G2 enroll adjudicator key (KMS-backed, disjoint custody) -> G3 produce and verify genesis independent attestation -> durable AUTH-012 enrollment. G4 dual-witness applies at terminal/Operational certification.
externalBlockers.required_authority: Enrolled AUTH-012 Board decision; AUTH-009 (Separation of Duties, terminal authority); AUTH-008 (S1/S3/S4)
externalBlockers.last_review_determination: PARTIAL — mechanism design-complete, ledger restoration VERIFIED, 0 independent attestations, gate G1-G4 = 0/4, closure criteria C1-C4 = 0/4. Closable only by the Authority Board via G1; NOT closable by this program (SIG-5).

review_trigger.reopenWhen: ANY watched evidence advances beyond its baseline state, OR a new independent adjudicator designation, registered adjudicator key, genesis attestation, or AUTH-012 Board authority action is recorded.

externalBlockers.rediscoveryNote: Phase G.1 already produced the definitive determination. Absent a review trigger, re-auditing REAL-C-05 yields the same PARTIAL result and only consumes tokens. DO NOT REINVESTIGATE without new evidence.
